senses.gloss: भाम् भाम् (rather a denomin. derived from भाम), i. 1, Ātm., and i. 10, Par. To be angry or wrathful.

भाम भा + म,
 I. m.
 1. Light.
 2. The sun.
 3. Passion, wrath.
 4. A sister's husband.
 II. f. मा. A passionate [] woman.
 --Cf. probably A.S. beam, a sun-beam, beamian, to shine (cf. the last).

भामिन् भामिन्, i. e. भाम + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Passionate, Ragh. 8, 28.
 II. f. नी, A passionate woman, often used, as a term of endearment, in the same sense as मानिनी.
